name: run
description: Run a regression from its simcrux.yaml and return each test's status, failure message, log and waveform, failures first. Writes what simcrux --ci writes for that config. Long; cancelling stops it.

filter.description: Only tests whose id contains this.

name: results
description: The results of a finished run, read from its results.ndjson. Runs nothing.

name: test
description: One test of a run: status, failure message, the end of its log with the first failing line, seed and parameters, and its waveform.

name: trend
description: A test's history across runs: status and runtime in each. At Pro, also its flakiness class.

runs.description: results.ndjson files, any order, at most 200.
